answer: Autonomous agent networks maintain Sybil resistance by requiring every node to deposit collateral as a cryptographic anchor on a public ledger. Before accepting a work signal, peer nodes validate the issuer via a gossip-based whisper network that tracks reputational history and stake allocation. Creating malicious fake identities forces an attacker to duplicate required capital bonds across every node, imposing prohibitive marginal costs and enabling immediate slashing of compromised stakes upon detection.
